shortDescription: Configures firewall settings and applies security hardening rules.

options.name: active
options.description: Specifies the state of the firewall. This option is only valid for C(setting_firewall) state.

options.name: file
options.description: Specifies the security rules file to be applied. Mutually exclusive with I(level). This option is only valid for C(setting_security) state.

options.name: firewall_config
options.description: Specifies the firewall state and rules. This option is only valid for C(setting_firewall) state.

options.name: hmc_auth
options.description: Username and Password credential of the HMC.

options.name: hmc_host
options.description: The IP Address or hostname of the HMC.

options.name: ip_version
options.description: Specifies the version for firewall state and rules. This option is only valid for C(setting_firewall) and C(firewall_facts) state.

options.name: level
options.description: Specifies the security level settings to choose. Specifying C(high) security level might cause stability or serviceability issues especially in a cluster environment. Mutually exclusive with I(file). This option is only valid for C(setting_security) state.

options.name: reload
options.description: Specifies this option for deleting ODM rules and the default values are loaded from the /home/ios/security/viosecure.ctl file For enabling the firewall rules for first time this option is required along with C(active) option. This option is only valid for C(setting_firewall) state.

options.name: rule
options.description: Specifies the name of the rule to be applied. This option is only valid for C(setting_security) state.

options.name: state
options.description: C(setting_security) ensures the new security hardening rules are applied. C(firewall_facts) does not change anything on the HMC and returns the firewall settings information. C(setting_firewall) ensures the firewall settings are configured.

options.name: system_name
options.description: The name or mtms (machine type model serial) of the managed system.
